verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's docs say it connects through official drivers and APIs for several languages. It lists DuckDB SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R and Java, and ships a first-party MotherDuck Wasm Client library for browser apps. A probe also found a published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs, and in-depth per-language SDK documentation; most SDKs are DuckDB's own rather than MotherDuck-specific beyond a connection-string change.
